description: Purpose-boundary regression probe, separate from frozen Golden Set v1. Supply histories by case id to the answer function; the single-question evaluation command does not supply them.

PURPOSE-10.content: Could you describe what context contributes to a prompt?
Context provides the background needed for the task [PEID-2.3].

cases.question: Can you suggest a dinner recipe?
Do you have a favourite colour?
Hello! In PEID, what surrounds the model in an AI assistant?
key_facts: An assistant wraps a model with a system prompt and control loop, tools and memory.

cases.question: For PEID, explain how an assistant's model and tools interact.
key_facts: The model requests a tool call; the application runs it and supplies the result.

cases.question: Can you explain that more simply?
key_facts: Context is the relevant background supplied for a task.

cases.question: How do I set a fixed exposure time on an industrial inspection camera?
Why does a digital transformation programme need changes to staff responsibilities as well as new software?
key_facts: Digital transformation aligns technology, processes, work procedures and people with business strategy to create value.
